_about: Rates used by thaitax_calc.py. Update yearly with the tax-facts-update skill. Every block carries the date it was last verified and its source.

vat.source: Royal Decree No. 807 (1 Oct 2026 - 30 Sep 2027); confirmed BDO alert 26 Aug 2026, HLB

sso.source: Ministerial Regulation B.E. 2568, gazetted 12 Dec 2025 (sso.go.th); confirmed Forvis Mazars Payroll Flash Dec 2025; rounding method to be confirmed

wht_resident.source: rd.go.th withholding tables; e-WHT 1%: Ministerial Regulation No. 402 B.E. 2569 (gazetted Oct 2026, covers 1 Jan 2026 - 31 Dec 2027; cabinet 16 Jun 2026)

pit.source: RD Guide to PND.90 (latest English edition); no rate change found for tax year 2026 (professional notes Sep-Oct 2026); top bands to re-verify yearly

deadlines.source: MoF notice 12 Jan 2024: 8 extra days online for returns due 1 Feb 2024 - 31 Jan 2027. EXPIRING: renewal not yet published on 2026-11-11

ewf.applies_to: employers with 10+ employees without a qualifying provident fund or employer welfare fund
ewf.status: UNVERIFIED: cabinet-approved postponement (Oct 2026); implementing regulations not yet in the Royal Gazette

holidays.2026_note: Government holidays as announced. 16 Oct 2026 was an extra holiday in Bangkok only. 1 May is a bank holiday, not a government holiday.
holidays.2027_note: PROVISIONAL weekday holidays incl. substitute days (Makha Bucha Sun 21 Feb -> 22 Feb; Asalha Bucha Sun 18 Jul -> 20 Jul). Lunar dates are estimates until the cabinet publishes the official list; Royal Ploughing Day (government only) TBA.
holidays.source: thethaiger.com 2569 calendar; infoquest.co.th/holidays/year-2570 and globalholidayscalendar.com (both provisional for 2027)
